question: What does a fixed escape plan need to know about where flood water enters, and what should it do with a zone-level alarm?
network: Anonymized CAD-derived mine network (1,592 junctions, 2,084 tunnels, 248 km, 4 shaft-bottom exits); flood schedules from the volume-transfer model, cached in 实验_07/fields and 实验_07/upper
sources_and_origins: All 1,587 non-exit, non-auxiliary junctions are both possible sources (one per flood) and starting points

plans_compared.shortest: Shortest dry route to the nearest shaft, ignoring the alarm
plans_compared.avoid_zone: Among routes to a shaft, the shortest of those with the least tunnel length touching the alarm zone (origin exempt)
plans_compared.robust: Exact shortest single route that works for every source in the alarm zone and every departure up to the delay target
plans_compared.exact_source: Best route chosen with the exact source known (single-source latest departure); an upper bound for any plan

experiments.E1_delay: Quadrant zones; delay targets 0,5,10,15,20,30,45,60,90,120 min; inflow 0.5 m3/s
experiments.E2_resolution: Recursive equal-tunnel-length bisection into 1,2,4,...,128 zones, three cutting angles (0,60,120 deg), plus quadrants and two partitions cut through the shaft cluster (2 and 4 zones); 30 min for all; 10 and 60 min for angle 0, quadrants and shaft cuts
experiments.E3_breadth: Quadrant zones restricted to sources within 50,100,200,500,1000 m of CAD-marked water areas; 30 min
experiments.E4_inflow: Inflow 1.0 m3/s (all flood times halved): quadrants at 10,30,60 min; angle-0 zone series at 30 min

metrics.zone_level: Starting points protected, split into inside and outside the alarm zone
metrics.whole_mine: Share of (starting point, source) pairs for which the plan for the source's zone is guaranteed; every source equally likely
metrics.cost: Extra length of the robust route over the shortest route; caps evaluated after the fact since the robust route is the shortest qualifying route

checks: Reproduce 实验_07 quadrant results at 10/20/30 min exactly; independent forward walks of sampled robust and zone-avoiding routes against every zone source; partition validity
limitations: Uncalibrated flood proxy; zones are geometric stand-ins for sensor zones; junction counts are not worker counts
